title: Complete installed CLI capability isolation
objective: Use proven Codex CLI 0.152.0 per-run controls to suppress unselected skill, app, and collaboration instruction surfaces, and version the exact-route contract so new selections fail closed while immutable earlier snapshots remain valid.
scope: Codex per-run skill and instruction isolation flags
exact route, Gearbox decision, and policy snapshot schema versioning
focused deterministic tests and concise documentation

may: inspect the named repository files with direct source and rg commands
modify the named route, Runner, validation, test, and documentation files
may_not: modify global configuration, global skills, plugins, Herdr, wake transport, siblings, or .opsle authority
invoke another provider, review route, web, MCP, plugin, subagent, or fallback

relevant_context: Installed codex-cli 0.152.0 debug prompt-input proved that skills.enabled=false, skills.include_instructions=false, include_apps_instructions=false, and include_collaboration_mode_instructions=false remove the unselected skill and app catalog from model-visible input.
features multi_agent and multi_agent_v2 remain disabled, so platform-managed team boilerplate does not expose a callable subagent tool.

An earlier immutable v2 policy snapshot used exact-child-route/v1 before selected_tool existed; later source reused that schema after adding selected_tool and now invalidates the earlier accepted attempt.
Version new exact routes, Gearbox decisions, and snapshots. Validate legacy immutable contracts compatibly, while requiring selected_tool fail closed for every newly created route.
expected_deliverable: Per-run model-visible capability suppression plus versioned exact-route contracts that validate immutable history without weakening new-route enforcement.
expected_evidence: launch argument assertions for every installed CLI isolation control
legacy snapshot compatibility and new snapshot fail-closed assertions
acceptance_criteria: tool-none Codex launches set skills.enabled=false and skills.include_instructions=false
tool-none Codex launches set include_apps_instructions=false and include_collaboration_mode_instructions=false
apps, plugins, skill search, multi_agent, and multi_agent_v2 remain disabled
new routes use incremented exact route, Gearbox decision, and policy snapshot schemas and require selected_tool
immutable earlier v1 exact-route snapshots validate under their historical contract
missing or invalid selected_tool fails validation for every newly created route
